# Error Handling Checklist: Harness-Gardening Drift Guards

**Purpose**: Validate error-handling requirement quality for malformed repo artifacts, missing metadata, unknown owners, warning/failure classification, sanitized diagnostics, redaction, unsafe paths, and optional detector skips.
**Created**: 2026-06-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Malformed Artifacts And Missing Metadata

- [x] CHK001 Are required unreadable, malformed, schema-invalid, unsupported-format, and too-large repo artifact failures mapped to closed error codes with objective CI failure behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019; Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK002 Is the `artifact_too_large` condition quantified with explicit byte limits for guarded repo artifacts and fixture inputs? [Resolved] [Spec §FR-029; Data Model §Guard Error]
- [x] CHK003 Is missing or empty required owner metadata in `docs/ai/repo-knowledge-index.json` distinguished from a derived drift finding whose owner is unknown? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008; Data Model §Owner Metadata]
- [x] CHK004 Are malformed Markdown and JSON artifacts required to produce bounded sanitized diagnostics without relying on raw parser output? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020; Data Model §Guard Error]

## Warning And Failure Policy

- [x] CHK005 Is CI failure limited to required artifact errors and high-confidence repo-owned drift while optional detector inputs and unknown owners remain warning-only? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010; Spec §FR-011; Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK006 Are optional detector skips required to surface `detector_status: "skipped_detector"` with a closed error code and bounded message? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021; Contract §detector_status]
- [x] CHK007 Are report summary counts required to include required errors, warning-severity findings, warning records, and optional detector skip warnings without double-counting? [Measurability, Spec §FR-023; Data Model §Report Envelope]

## Sanitized Diagnostics And Redaction

- [x] CHK008 Are guard error records limited to repo-relative source path, detector, closed code, bounded message, required flag, and redaction flag? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020; Contract §guard_error]
- [x] CHK009 Are the semantics for when `redacted` must be `true` versus `false` explicitly defined for sanitized diagnostics? [Resolved] [Spec §FR-030; Data Model §Guard Error]
- [x] CHK010 Are JSON and Markdown reports forbidden from exposing raw artifact content, absolute host paths, stack traces, environment values, credential-like values, or matched substrings? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020; Spec §SC-009]

## Unsafe Paths And Fixture Containment

- [x] CHK011 Are reported paths constrained to repo-relative POSIX paths that reject absolute paths, parent traversal, and Windows separators? [Completeness, Contract §repo_relative_path]
- [x] CHK012 Are fixture input paths required to normalize within the fixture mini-tree before reads, including explicit handling for containment escape attempts? [Resolved] [Spec §FR-031; Data Model §Fixture Case]
- [x] CHK013 Is `fixture_unsafe_path` always a required failure rather than a warning-only detector skip? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications; Spec §FR-021]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK014 Can every closed error code be exercised by deterministic fixtures with expected required-vs-optional status? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-009; Quickstart §Validate Fixture Behavior]
- [x] CHK015 Can report redaction, message bounds, path bounds, optional skip status, and required-failure exit behavior be objectively checked without live state? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-009; Quickstart §Produce Deterministic JSON]
- [x] CHK016 Are error-handling checks kept process/tooling-only without runtime, service, database, GitHub, or scheduler inspection? [Scope, Spec §FR-018; Plan §Structure Decision]
